text: The initiative includes a probabilistic seismic hazard model (PSHA19/NSHA-PNG) that provides updated ground shaking estimates. The Interim Amendment integrates this hazard into PNG’s design practice with modern load assessment methods. The initiative also features capacity-building through in-country seminars and professional development videos to support adoption. The alignment with Australian and New Zealand methods ensures regional consistency and leverages familiar methodologies among practitioners.
